name: hub-bases-v2
status: design, unvalidated: never built in Studio, played or measured on a device

conventions.units: studs; the open-world hub frame of layout-v1.json (origin at the hub centre, x east, z south)
conventions.yaw: rotation_y_deg as CFrame.Angles(0, rad, 0); local +X = (cos r, -sin r), local +Z = (sin r, cos r)
conventions.front: a piece faces along its local -Z (its Front face); bases and gate signs face the lobby
conventions.bearing: centre + radius * (cos b, sin b): 0 east, 90 south, 180 west, 270 north
conventions.station_local: station local (lx, lz) is in its base's frame: -lz toward the lobby, +lx to the right
conventions.heights: floor top y 0.5; base pad top y 0.9

supersedes.why: the hub expansion (docs/design/wildbound-hub-expansion.md): a 100 disc is the most layout-v1's region squares (x -100 and 100) allow; bases grow to 29 x 24 for a chest zone, a showcase stands in front of each base, four shop circles sit on the lawn ring
supersedes.transitions: the transitions vanish: the hub disc meets both region squares; the fog and every beast stay beyond x -135 and x 340

rules_sign.text:
Plaza segura
Sin peleas ni bestias

budget.why: the hub is always loaded (ModelStreamingMode Persistent); 480 parts and 36 shadowless PointLights raise layout-v1's cap of 400 parts on purpose and are unmeasured: record frame time on a phone with 8 players before accepting

lighting.note: client-only: WildboundAtmosphere gains a 'hub' zone row; inside inside_radius the world client blends to it over blend_studs, so the forest outside stays dark; PointLights stay shadowless

walk_times.note: straight lines at the walk speed, no sprint; a lower bound

open_world_changes.why: the radius-100 disc leaves it 13.7 studs from the hub, under the 20-stud safe margin; the open-world planner must apply and re-check this move
